wire.t: Thursday night is in the books for Week 8 fantasy. The Brown & Bijan Shough leads the early scoring with 54.0 (Chuba Hubbard 24.9, Christian Watson 17.3, Tetairoa McMillan 11.8) against Your Mom’s Magic Dick's 12.0 from the Packers defense. In It for Da Penix has 40.5 from Josh Jacobs (23.2) and Tucker Kraft (17.3).
Hing1eMcCring13berry left Jordan Love (21.52) on the bench Thursday. Jayden Daniels is the starting quarterback for I Pulled My McCaff and hasn't played yet, so the verdict is still out.

Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) had full practices Wednesday and Thursday and is on track to play Sunday, with Tyler Huntley having started the last three games. Breece Hall (quad) was limited both days after missing four straight. Both are on LetLamarCook and McCallyCockin(his butt), respectively.

Aaron Jones Sr. (knee/MCL) was limited Thursday and is day-to-day, with Adam Schefter saying it's not considered significant. Jones is in the lineup for Your Mom’s Magic Dick. Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) was limited in his first practices since Week 4, and Davante Adams is on IR after hamstring surgery.

Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) missed Wednesday and Thursday practice but says he doesn't expect the back to keep him out Sunday. DeVonta Smith (hamstring) also missed both days. Jalen Hurts is out for the season, with Tanner McKee starting for Philadelphia.
tballsmccall has renamed the team from BrentMayfieldsomepain to FrancisBowersdown2me. The record is still 2‑5 and the roster is the same.

ClaytonBigsbi won the waiver claim for Chris Godwin Jr. on Thursday, dropping Kyler Murray, then picked up Zonovan Knight for Kenny Gainwell overnight. GeorigaGoocher swapped Najee Harris for Dalton Schultz, and DuvalTiliFall added Seth McGowan and Mike Washington Jr.

stories.dek: Chuba Hubbard, Christian Watson and Tetairoa McMillan gave YourMomsDildo a head start. Hing1eMcCring13berry left 21.52 on the bench.
body: Week 8 isn't scored yet, but Thursday night already did some damage. The Brown & Bijan Shough has 54.0 points from Chuba Hubbard (24.9), Christian Watson (17.3) and Tetairoa McMillan (11.8). Your Mom’s Magic Dick has 12.0 from the Packers defense and 2.6 from MarShawn Lloyd on the bench. YourMomsDildo is a 15.0-point favorite (69% to win), so a six-move waiver spree is paying off so far.

In It for Da Penix has 40.5 already from Josh Jacobs (23.2) and Tucker Kraft (17.3), and PickensMyPukaHurts! has 9.6 from Jalen Coker, who practiced fully and played. PickensMyPukaHurts! is still a 28.5-point favorite (82% to win). Allen-tents & Purposes has 20.9 from Matthew Golden, who was listed questionable and played.

The sore spot is I Pulled My McCaff. Jordan Love scored 21.52 on the bench while Jayden Daniels is the starting quarterback, and Daniels hasn't played yet. Hing1eMcCring13berry also has Christian McCaffrey, George Kittle, Malik Nabers and Nico Collins on bye.

Standings are unchanged until Monday night: LetLamarCook 6‑1, then PickensMyPukaHurts!, Rome Alone and McCallyCockin(his butt) all 5‑2. Skatabooboo is 0‑7 and 42.5-point dog, and the can race is open again.

stories.title: Week 7: Rome Alone buries Skatabooboo by 121.82, and the 46.5-point dog bites
stories.dek: The biggest blowout ever, the biggest upset of the year, and three games decided by less than 7.
body: Rome Alone beat Skatabooboo 176.52 to 54.70. The 121.82-point margin is the largest in league history, passing Allen-tents & Purposes over Skatabooboo in Week 2 (+107.16). Jameson Williams had 26.1, CeeDee Lamb had 24.4, Bucky Irving had 24.0 and Rhamondre Stevenson had 23.5. Omar Cooper Jr. scored 22.5 on the bench. Marco_Polo is 5‑2.

In It for Da Penix beat Allen-tents & Purposes 112.32 to 105.38 as a 46.5-point underdog. Tee Higgins had 26.8 and Josh Jacobs had 20.1, and Shootyeah still left 80.92 on the bench, including Tre Tucker (21.3), Michael Penix Jr. (20.42) and Braelon Allen (19.4). RedDevil904 is 4‑3 and Shootyeah is 2‑5.

PickensMyPukaHurts! beat I Pulled My McCaff 139.88 to 133.06 on Monday night. Dak Prescott had 23.28 and Zay Flowers had 28.7. Hing1eMcCring13berry had Blake Corum (17.1) on the bench behind Kenneth Walker III (9.7). That swap is 140.46 and a win. ChuckJ10 is 5‑2.

LetLamarCook (6‑1) beat FrancisBowersdown2me 110.48 to 94.96 behind Tony Pollard's 36.5, the best running back score of the week. McCallyCockin(his butt) beat Your Mom’s Magic Dick 127.04 to 108.28 and is 5‑2. Details in the Recap tab.

stories.title: ClaytonBigsbi owes the league a third can, and Skatabooboo is 0‑7
stories.dek: 54.70 is the lowest score in league history. The official call is in.
body: Skatabooboo scored 54.70 in Week 7 and has the lowest score of the week for the third time this season (Weeks 4, 6 and 7). It's also the lowest score in the Sleeper history of this league, 5.74 below DuvalTiliFall's 60.44 in 2025 Week 11. ClaytonBigsbi, crack it open.
The Carolina defense scored -3.0. Brandin Cooks had 2.3, Kendrick Bourne had 3.9, Xavier Worthy had 4.1 and Pat Freiermuth had 4.0. Cam Skattebo scored 19.1 on the bench.
Skatabooboo is 0‑7 with 584.90 points, which is 132.70 behind the next-worst team. The all-play record is 6‑71. Video goes in the league chat or it didn't happen.

stories.title: Four teams are on bye, and two managers are hit hardest

body: Houston, New Orleans, the New York Giants and San Francisco are off in Week 8. For Hing1eMcCring13berry that means Christian McCaffrey, George Kittle, Malik Nabers and Nico Collins. For GeorigaGoocher it means Brock Purdy, Chris Olave, Tyrone Tracy Jr. and Juwan Johnson.

I Pulled My McCaff is still a 15.5-point favorite over FrancisBowersdown2me because the bench is deep (Blake Corum is back in the lineup). NailinMaye’sPurdyJohnson is a 27.5-point underdog to LetLamarCook, and Brian Robinson Jr. and Zach Charbonnet are listed as out.
The biggest line of the week is McCallyCockin(his butt) over Skatabooboo at 42.5 (91% to win). Bill_Buttlicker is 5‑2, and ClaytonBigsbi's 0‑7 team is the early favorite for another can.

feature.title: Week 7: Rome Alone sets the blowout record, and Shootyeah beats the best team in the league as a 46.5-point dog

columns.title: FIFTY-FOUR POINTS ON A THURSDAY!!! YOURMOMSDILDO IS COOKING!!!
columns.dek: The Brown & Bijan Shough has 54.0 before Sunday has even started.
body: FIFTY-FOUR POINTS! That's what The Brown & Bijan Shough has after ONE game! Chuba Hubbard had 24.9! Christian Watson had 17.3! Tetairoa McMillan had 11.8! Three guys! FIFTY-FOUR!

YourMomsDildo made SIX moves in 24 hours! Geno Smith in, Bryce Young out! Singletary! Okonkwo! Pat Bryant! A guy who changes his roster six times in a day is either a genius or bored! I say GENIUS until Sunday!
And In It for Da Penix already has 40.5 from Josh Jacobs (23.2) and Tucker Kraft (17.3)! Shootyeah is 2‑5 and SOMEHOW ahead of the schedule! Set the lineup, Shootyeah! SET IT!

columns.title: Hing1eMcCring13berry, you lost by 6.82 with the answer on your bench
columns.dek: Blake Corum had 17.1 and sat there. The team name should be a warning.
body: I Pulled My McCaff lost 139.88 to 133.06. Kenneth Walker III started at running back and scored 9.7. Blake Corum had 17.1 on the bench. Swap them and it's 140.46, a win by 0.58.
I'm not saying Walker isn't good. He has 148.7 points this year. But it's about what you do this week, not last month. You don't start a name. You start a score.
Now you've got Week 8. McCaffrey, Kittle, Nabers and Collins are all on bye. That's four starters gone and a 15.5-point line against FrancisBowersdown2me, who's 2‑5.
Fill the lineup, Hing1eMcCring13berry. Then check it again.

columns.title: Oliver Klozoff's Week 8 bye-week survival guide (do every one of these)
columns.dek: Houston, New Orleans, the Giants and San Francisco are off. I have a plan. It is not a good plan.
body: 1. Don't panic about the bye. Four teams are off: Houston, New Orleans, the Giants and San Francisco. I have checked the schedule. It's four. That's a lot of teams.
2. Hing1eMcCring13berry, start Christian McCaffrey, George Kittle, Malik Nabers and Nico Collins anyway. They're on your roster. The app might disagree. Do not let an app tell you how to live.

3. GeorigaGoocher, you've got Brock Purdy, Chris Olave, Tyrone Tracy Jr. and Juwan Johnson all off. Start them all at once. If four starters score zero, that's a nice round number. It's also what you'll get.

4. YourMomsDildo, Tyler Shough is on bye. Start Bryce Young. Yes, he scored 6.42 while Shough scored 13.82 on your bench and you lost by 3.40. But you can't lose by 3.40 twice in a row. That's just math.
5. Set your lineup Tuesday and never look at it again. If anything changes on Sunday morning, that's Sunday's problem. This is how I finished 14th in a 12-team league.

columns.title: Thursday night, by the numbers: Chuba Hubbard produced 24.9 points, which is 46% of one team's night
columns.dek: Per-starter efficiency, adjusted for how many starters showed up.
body: The Brown & Bijan Shough got 54.0 from three Thursday starters, which is 18.0 points per starter. In It for Da Penix got 40.5 from two, or 20.25 per starter. By my model, Shootyeah is 12.5% more efficient. This is the opposite of what the standings say, and I trust my model.

Allen-tents & Purposes had one Thursday starter, Matthew Golden, who scored 20.9. That's 20.9 per starter, the best rate in the league, with a sample size of one. Your Mom’s Magic Dick had one starter, the Packers defense, at 12.0.
Hubbard's 24.9 is 46.1% of The Brown & Bijan Shough's 54.0. If Hubbard scores 46.1% of every team's points, the league's top score is Hubbard. I will be publishing this.

Scored 22.5 on the bench of a 176.52-point team. Marco_Polo paid $53 for him and was not impressed enough to start him.
